name: BountyVerdict Agent Decision Tools
tagline: Evidence-linked decision gates for coding agents, GitHub work, and MCP changes
description: Remote, account-free MCP server for preflight decisions on public GitHub bounties, agent instructions, Actions failures, flaky retries, and MCP tool-catalog changes. Six read-only tools return evidence-linked verdicts and request x402 USDC payment only after valid input.

install.notes: This server exposes six read-only tools. Connecting and listing tools are free. Valid unpaid calls return x402 v2 Base USDC payment requirements; invalid input is rejected before payment. A remote Cline connection does not provide a wallet: direct automatic payment requires an x402-aware MCP client, while standard hosts may use the versioned exact-HTTP handoff only through a separately installed and authorized x402 wallet.
